messages.text: Hey team — we first noticed elevated error rates in order-service around 6pm Monday. Not alarming yet but worth watching. Error rate went from 0.2% to 1.8%.
I see it too. Could be the new API gateway rollout we did this afternoon? @steven.buchanan did that go out around 5:30?
Yes, API gateway v2.4.1 went out at 17:28 UTC. But I thought we had canary running. Let me check logs.
Canary looks fine. Error rate is ticking down. Probably a transient. I'll keep watching.
🚨 We have a SEV-1. Order processing is down. Error rate hit 34%. Customers are calling support. Paging on-call now.
On it. Looking at the DB. Connection pool is maxed out — all 200 connections in use. Order service is hanging waiting for connections.
This started Monday night with the API gateway rollout. The gateway is probably not releasing connections properly.
Restarted connection pool manager. Error rate dropping. But still seeing ~8% failures. Root cause is connection pool exhaustion, NOT the gateway.
We ran a DB migration script last night (Aug 12 → 13) around 11pm. Rebuilt some indexes on orders table. Could that have caused Monday's issue? Timeline doesn't add up.
No the migration was AFTER the incident started. Monday was definitely the gateway rollout causing connection leaks. Migration may have made it worse Wednesday.
Fix deployed. Error rate back to 0.1%. Marking incident mitigated. Roughly 60+ orders were affected across all customers.
Heads up — Contoso is still reporting issues on specific orders. Looks like some orders got stuck in a bad state and weren't cleaned up. @nancy.davolio can you look?
